text:
jess_cs: Heads up — MosaicAI's London demo is getting blocked by regional QPS caps. Demo is 2026-04-10 14:00 BST; they see 60 rps bursts (~216k tokens/min). Current EU edge policy limits them to 30 QPS. Renewal flagged as at-risk if the demo fails. Can we do a timeboxed allowlist + temporary QPS bump for the demo window? @mira_netops @vinay_sre

mira_netops: What's the account id and source IPs? We should auto-revoke after the window.

jess_cs: Account: acct_mosaic_42. Customer proxies: 34.72.148.0/24, 34.72.149.0/24. Requesting eu-west-2 (London) edge peering + allowlist for those CIDRs and QPS override to 150 for 72h starting 2026-04-10T13:30:00Z. Auto-revoke 2026-04-13T13:30:00Z. Demo keys prefixed mosaic-demo-. Renewal owner is me.

vinay_sre: 150 QPS ok from infra POV if we put them on the dedicated burst pool. Note: put a fallback in place if traffic >200 QPS. I'll enable a canary fallback to gpt-small-ml for non-critical calls. Also create an ops ticket and monitoring.

lena_eng: Quick ask — what's the average prompt length for the demo? If it's ~120 tokens we can enable prefix/KV warmup caching to cut downstream load during warmup.

jess_cs: They've given sample prompts — avg prompt ~110-130 tokens, chat style. Warmup planned 15 mins before demo.

mira_netops: Preparing config. Quick internal apply snippet: 
```
POST /internal/allowlist
{
  "account": "acct_mosaic_42",
  "cidrs": ["34.72.148.0/24","34.72.149.0/24"],
  "region": "eu-west-2",
  "qps_override": 150,
  "expires_at": "2026-04-13T13:30:00Z",
  "reason": "mosaic demo - renewal at-risk"
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Request received for acct_mosaic_42. Validation passed. Applying allowlist + qps override in eu-west-2.

vinay_sre: Routing rule deployed. Canary fallback to gpt-small-ml set at 5% traffic. Monitoring: alert if 95th percentile latency >250ms or QPS >180. I'll escalate if we see any routing thrash.

jess_cs: Amazing, thank you. I'll confirm with the customer and note on the renewal tracker. Please add a line: 'onboard demo support — temporal QPS bump; watch billing delta'.

mira_netops: Logged as CS-1829 in Ops tracker and added the auto-revoke task. DMing @jess_cs the rollback ID and final revocation timestamp now.

jess_cs: :thumbsup: Closing the loop here. Will follow up after demo with feedback and whether renewal needs additional concessions.
